card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 34.0 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, KN Cen: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 171.6 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 3,748 parsecs away.
